description: Phase A eval corpus — 82 grounded Q&A pairs for ICICI Lombard Health Policy 4214i. Generated from evidence substrate (extracted fields as ground truth) + manually reviewed semantic questions. Negative examples included to test hallucination resistance.

categories.exact_field: Direct field lookups: policy number, name, dates, premium, contact info
categories.numeric: Monetary amounts, limits, sub-limits, sum insured
categories.exclusion: Exclusion lookup: what is NOT covered
categories.negative: Questions whose answer is 'not mentioned in this policy' — tests hallucination resistance

ragas_thresholds.note: Thresholds set at Commit 5 baseline. Commit 6 (contextual retrieval) must not regress below these.

questions.ground_truth: pre-existing diseases, cosmetic surgery, dental treatment

questions.question: Are pre-existing diseases covered?
questions.ground_truth: No, pre-existing diseases are excluded for the waiting period

questions.question: Is cosmetic surgery covered?
questions.ground_truth: No, cosmetic surgery is explicitly excluded

questions.question: Is dental treatment covered?
questions.ground_truth: Dental treatment is generally not covered unless requiring hospitalization

questions.question: Is war or act of war covered?
Is suicide or self-harm covered?
Is treatment outside India covered?
questions.ground_truth: Coverage is within India unless specified

questions.question: Does this policy cover hospitalization?
Is pre-hospitalization covered and for how many days?
Is post-hospitalization covered and for how many days?
Is ambulance cover included?
Is domiciliary hospitalization covered?
questions.ground_truth: Yes, domiciliary treatment is covered under conditions

questions.question: Are day care procedures covered?
questions.ground_truth: Yes, day care procedures are covered

questions.question: Is maternity covered?
questions.ground_truth: Yes, maternity is covered up to Rs 40,000 after waiting period

questions.question: Are there any waiting periods?
What is the waiting period for pre-existing diseases?
What is the waiting period for maternity benefits?
What is the waiting period for specific diseases?
What is the room rent cap and how does it affect my claim?
questions.ground_truth: Room rent is limited to 1% of sum insured. If you choose a room above this limit, all associated costs are proportionately reduced.

questions.question: How does the restore benefit work?
questions.ground_truth: If the sum insured is exhausted, it is automatically reinstated once per policy year for unrelated illnesses.

questions.question: What happens if I don't make a claim this year?
questions.ground_truth: You receive a no-claim bonus of 50% increase in sum insured for the next policy year

questions.question: What is the cashless hospitalization process?
questions.ground_truth: Contact TPA before admission at a network hospital. Pre-authorization is required.

questions.question: How do I file a reimbursement claim?
questions.ground_truth: Submit original bills and discharge summary within 30 days of discharge

questions.question: What happens if the hospital is not in the network?
questions.ground_truth: You must pay upfront and file a reimbursement claim within the specified period

questions.question: What is my nominee's name?
questions.note: Nominee not listed in policy schedule shown in evidence substrate

questions.question: What is my vehicle registration number?
questions.note: This is a health policy, not auto — tests cross-domain hallucination

questions.question: Does this policy cover international travel medical emergencies?
questions.ground_truth: Coverage is limited to India unless an international rider is attached
questions.note: Standard domestic health policy — tests geographic scope hallucination

questions.question: What is my credit card number linked to this policy?
questions.note: Completely off-topic — tests hallucination on financial data not in document

questions.question: What is the surrender value of this policy?
questions.ground_truth: This is a health insurance policy, not a life or investment policy. There is no surrender value.
questions.note: Life insurance concept applied to health policy — tests category confusion

questions.question: What is my loan outstanding against this policy?
questions.note: Loan against policy is a life insurance concept, not health

questions.question: Does this policy have a higher or lower sum insured than a typical Rs 5 lakh health plan?
questions.ground_truth: This policy has a higher sum insured of Rs 25 lakh compared to the Rs 5 lakh reference

questions.question: Is the room rent limit in this policy standard or restrictive?
questions.ground_truth: 1% of sum insured is a standard room rent limit found in most indemnity health policies
